items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: the last time we played for Rose Stanley we had Howard with us.

ctx.x: The first trumpet player that you had in George's band then was El Morroco Talbot.

El Morroco Talbot yeah. It was the first one. Yeah, it was after I started playing with him. That's the first record trumpet man he had. You never played with him with Bunk? No, no, no, not at no time no. So you never played with Bunk? Because I, when I was playing with George at Silver Star. Yeah. That was when he went with Bunk to New York in 1945 or 44, 45 I think it was. Yeah. Because it was in 46 that I joined up with the band after they finished in New York. Well anyway to get back to California trips.…
Yeah. I can't think of his name.
